triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The plan accurately distinguishes current milestone, acceptance, intent, evidence, and review owners and rejects a parallel writable acceptance matrix.
The plan specifies a reference-based verification topology and deterministic structural PLAN plus executable pre-REVIEW checks with authority and freshness semantics.
The plan provides bounded implementation waves, rollout, negative controls, process-fact obligations, metrics, risks, decisions, and an audit rubric without claiming runtime completion.

note: Documentation-only contract for the B-4444 execution-plan deliverable; proposed runtime behavior is explicitly not shipped by this Story.
